summary: E2E test of Claim Builder patient dropdown + auto-invoice + editable DOS. Backend auto-creates invoice MB-0039 with qty=4 matched to the note's CPT (99203, $110 → total $440). Frontend ManagedSelect portal opens, remains open while scrolling inside the panel (verified via both mouse wheel and direct scroll event), and allows selecting patient by name. All i18n keys (dayFilesTitle/dayFilesHint/changeDate/applyDate) render translated in EN. cb-review renders with cb-edit-date + cb-apply-date; changing date and applying regenerates the packet with the new claim_number.

test_results.cb_patient_dropdown_opens: PASS (cb-patient-panel appears via portal, options rendered as cb-patient-opt-<id>)
test_results.cb_patient_scroll_keeps_open: PASS (panel remains after scrollTop=100 and mouse wheel inside the portal; ManagedSelect.onScroll early-return works)
test_results.cb_patient_select_by_name: PASS ('Test Patient' selected; button label updates)
test_results.cb_visits_load: PASS (3 visits shown, Signed / Unsigned badges)
test_results.cb_dayfiles_render: PASS (cb-dayfiles section shows checkboxes; 07/15/2026 lists 5 items)
test_results.cb_edit_date_apply: PASS (cb-edit-date fill + cb-apply-date regenerates packet with new claim_number)
test_results.auto_invoice_MB0039_qty4: PASS (POST /fmp/generate for a signed note with cpt_code 99203, no linked invoice → created invoice MB-0039, qty=4, amount=110, total=440, auto_generated=true)
test_results.i18n_no_raw_keys: PASS (dayFilesTitle/dayFilesHint/changeDate/applyDate replaced with translated strings in EN)

critical_code_review_comments: ClaimBuilder.js line 218/245 uses fmtDate(packet.claim_number) — claim_number is being used as the DOS date. Naming is misleading; consider renaming to service_date/dos in the response payload for clarity.
fmp.py auto-invoice at line 261 hardcodes quantity:4. If this ever needs to be configurable per CPT, expose it via cpt_codes.default_units instead of a magic number.
seed_data_creation: Auto-invoice MB-0039 created via /fmp/generate on note 536b02ac (07/14/2026 signed CPT 99203) then deleted post-verification. Also generated a review packet on note 91ae898c (07/15/2026) which persists as a claim_packet but has no auto-invoice (note lacks cpt_code — expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: For auto-invoice testing pick a signed note where cpt_code is populated AND no invoice exists on that service_date. The Test Patient has visit 07/14/2026 (note 536b02ac, CPT 99203) as a reliable trigger. seq_base is 39 so the first auto invoice always gets MB-0039. ManagedSelect scroll fix works: onScroll ignores events whose e.target is inside panelRef; verified with wheel + direct scroll dispatch.
